data.name: Hedayat
data.gender_notes: Hedayat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root h-d-y, meaning 'to guide'. This name signifies a person who is a source of guidance and enlightenment, both spiritually and practically. In Islamic tradition, Hedayat refers to the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who was sent as a guide and source of wisdom for humanity. The name Hedayat carries the meaning “Guiding Path, Enlightenment” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hedayat usually hope their child will grow to embody guiding path, enlightenment and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Hedayat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guiding Path, Enlightenment.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hedayat total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
